title: The Abomination of Desolation
lead: Daniel's phrase for the horror set up in the Temple that ends the daily offering (Daniel 9:27; 11:31; 12:11). 1 Maccabees uses it for what Antiochus IV's officers built on the altar in December 167 BC (1 Maccabees 1:54), and Jesus takes it up for a sign still to come (Matthew 24:15; Mark 13:14). Interpreters have identified it with Antiochus's altar, with Roman standards or armies in AD 70, with a future Antichrist, and with other things; the Hebrew may also be a mocking pun on Baal Shamem, "Lord of Heaven."
